mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO frontend_project_profile (workspace_id, repo_id, probe_id, branch, commit_sha, app_root, app_root_hash, package_name, detector_version, profile_json, evidence_json, looks_like_library, version, creator_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{repoId}, #{probeId}, #{branch}, #{commitSha}, #{appRoot}, #{appRootHash}, #{packageName}, #{detectorVersion}, #{profileJson}, #{evidenceJson}, #{looksLikeLibrary}, 0, #{creatorId})
